pages.text: It is quiet now. The voice has stopped talking. It does not need to anymore. I looked down into the water, and the water looked back. Cracks of cyan light, all over my face, all over my arms, running like rivers on a map. Dark where I used to be pale. Bright where I used to be dark. In my hand there is a black blade. I do not remember picking it up. I do not remember when I stopped looking like myself. I only remember that it felt like coming home.
